messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PDX-ENQUEUE-1 fired - embed-queue-growth-eu - 5m spike in pending requests, region=eu-west, threshold=queue_length>500. Auto-escalation in 3m if unacked. Link: https://pd.redwood.ai/alerts/PDX-ENQUEUE-1

samir: acked on PD. I'm looking at dashboards now. tagging @julia for oncall.

julia (oncall): I'm on it — joining bridge. Thanks @samir. Quick check: is this client-facing latency or internal queue backlog?

lee: manifests show backlog in embedder pool. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/embeds/queue?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west (spikes at 12:07 UTC).

samir: copy, running quick PromQL: `sum(rate(embed_request_queue{region="eu-west"}[1m])) by (service)` — queue incr 4x over baseline. error-rate up ~0.6% (5xx).

julia (oncall): opening runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/queue-fanout. First mitigation: increase dedicated pool and enable burst capacity. If that doesn't help, fallback to smaller model variant for embeddings.

eric: pushing a temporary scale up now: `rctl scale dedicated --pool embed-eu --replicas 6 --reason "autopage mitigation"` — watching for cold-starts.

samir: also toggled autoscale policy to be more aggressive: `kubectl patch hpa embed-eu-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"maxReplicas":12}}'`

julia (oncall): logs snippet from inference nodes (truncated):
```
[12:06:58] WARN kvcache: eviction lag 230ms, queue=672
[12:07:12] ERROR grpc: timeout dial to embedder-3: rpc error: code=Unavailable
[12:07:34] INFO worker: warmed instance embed-eu-07, ready
```

beth (support-liaison): heads-up for support — we should message affected customers once we have ETA. Preliminary list shows ~12 orgs with >95th latency jump. Draft message suggested: "We're seeing increased embedding latency in EU region; engineers are mitigating. We'll follow up with ETA within 30 minutes."

julia (oncall): current impact: degraded embedding latency from ~200ms to ~2s P50->P95 for impacted customers, ~0.6% error uplift. Customer-facing features that rely on embeddings may see slow responses. Not yet a data-loss issue.

samir: 5m update: queue length peaked at 820 then trending down to 380 after scale-up. CPU on embedder nodes dropping. Link to transient graph: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/embeds/queue?panel=3

lee: noticed PD escalations to tier2 if no progress; we've prevented flare by scaling. No manual failover yet.

julia (oncall): routing note: added temporary routing rule to prefer `embed-eu-small` variants for low-priority traffic to absorb tail — `route set lowprio variant=small region=eu-west` (testing now).

eric: result: low-prio traffic shifted, overall P95 improving to ~1.1s. High-prio still ~1.9s. Continuing to watch.

beth (support-liaison): sending draft to customers now (internal):
"Hi — we are investigating increased embedding latency in EU. We have scaled capacity and expect improvements within 15 minutes. No data loss. We’ll update within 30 minutes or when resolved. — Redwood Support"

julia (oncall): 15m update: metrics stabilizing. Queue steady ~260, error-rate back to baseline 0.03%. Planning handoff to @eric for rest of shift at 22:00 UTC.

samir: filing action item: investigate root cause of sudden burst — likely traffic replay from one customer or a bad client loop. Will add rate-limit telemetry to identify origin.

julia (oncall): handing off now to @eric. Handoff checklist:
- incident ticket: PD PDX-ENQUEUE-1 (link)
- actions taken: scaled dedicated pool + adjusted autoscale, routed low-prio to small variants, support notified
- current state: stabilized, monitoring for 30m
- follow-ups: postmortem and client telemetry correlation

eric: taking over. Noted all. I'll keep monitoring and run the correlation query to see if a single org is the culprit: `topk(5, sum(rate(embed_requests[5m])) by (org_id))`

julia (oncall): thanks @eric — feel free to escalate back if it regresses. closing bridge from my side. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Page PDX-ENQUEUE-1 acknowledged by julia (oncall) and auto-closed after stabilization criteria met. Please file a follow-up if you need a postmortem.

eric: quick note for the postmortem: collect `embed_request_logs` for 11:50-12:10 UTC and check client-side retries. Assigning to @samir to own the RCA.

beth (support-liaison): I've tagged affected customers and set expectation for a follow-up in the next 48 hours.

samir: ack — I’ll own RCA and provenance. Draft follow-up tasks: 1) add request-level spike alerts differentiated by org_id; 2) add circuit-breaker for >200 req/s per org; 3) replay test to validate autoscale knobs.

eric: final: monitoring dashboard looks green; closing incident thread. Thanks team. :tada:
